purpose: Teach: 夜明け/粘土/鴨/ピエロ/根っこ/裾/根気/生意気

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、夜明けまで、お祭りで踊ったな、私たち。
lines.en: In my youth, we danced at the festival until the sun came up.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Pause on 'danced'—as if feeling the music still. Slow, measured delivery. Voice trails to almost a whisper on 'us.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。孫が、粘土で、似顔絵、作ってくれたわよ、私の。
lines.en: Yes. Our grandchild made me a little portrait out of clay.
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost a smile in the voice. Small emphasis on 'made'—pride mixed with affection. Gentle, present in the moment despite the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、池の鴨を、よく見に行ったな、二人で、デートで。
lines.en: Back then, we'd often go watch the ducks at the pond together. Just the two of us on dates.
lines.style: Eyes softening further. Voice deepens slightly with the intimacy of the memory. Each phrase spaced like photographs. Fond, unhurried, almost protective of the detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 結婚式、ピエロの余興、新郎が、用意してくれてたわね。
lines.en: At our wedding, the groom had arranged a clown for entertainment. Do you remember?
lines.style: Quiet chuckle underlying the words—amusement at the memory. Voice brightens on 'clown,' then settles back to pensiveness. Turning slightly toward her, including her in the shared moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の木の根っこ、年々、強くなってきたな、立派だ。
lines.en: The roots of the tree in our garden have grown stronger every year. Really magnificent now.
lines.style: Observant, almost meditative tone. Slight emphasis on 'stronger'—drawing a quiet parallel. Voice carries quiet satisfaction, pride in what endures. Contemplative pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 着物の裾、お直しに出さないと、寸法、合わないわよ。
lines.en: Your kimono hem needs to be taken in. The length won't fit properly otherwise.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. No fussing—just clear statement of fact. Warm undertone, though; this is care expressed as problem-solving, not complaint.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人生、根気で乗り切ってきたな、二人で。
lines.en: We've made it through life by patience, haven't we? The two of us.
lines.style: Deeper, more deliberate. Words weighted with quiet recognition. Gentle firmness on 'patience'—this is earned wisdom. Voice settles into a place of earned peace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫、生意気な口、たまに、きくようになってきたわね、頼もしい。
lines.en: Our grandchild's getting cheeky with their words sometimes now. But it's reassuring, really.
lines.style: Warmth with a note of pride underneath. Slight indulgence on 'cheeky'—this is affection, not disapproval. Softens on the final phrase, voice nearly conspiratorial, as if telling her a secret she already knows.
